newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran air force jet crashes, pilot injured.
newsitem.headline: Iran air force jet crashes, pilot injured.

text.p: An Iranian air force jet crashed during a training mission in the southwestern region of Behbahan, injuring the pilot, Iran's official news agency IRNA said on Sunday.
IRNA, monitored by the British Broadcasting Corporation, quoted an informed source as saying the F-7 fighter jet took off from the Omidiyyeh base near the town of Ahvaz.
The pilot was taken to hospital for treatment, the source added. He gave no cause for the crash.
